text: {"assertions":["A bug in search/indexer/chunker.ts caused truncated documents during indexing, where chunk offsets stopped short of the document length.","The truncation bug only manifested for records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause was a mutable default argument that was shared across function calls in the chunker.","The fix involved making the default argument empty and building the value fresh on each call, implemented in PR #1910 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1.","The fix dramatically improved p99 latency performance, reducing it from 8.9 seconds to 20 milliseconds.","The bug could be reproduced by indexing the long changelog fixture.","The module is tested by search/indexer/chunker.test.ts.","The implementation stack uses TypeScript."]}
